title: Lysimachus
summary: Raleigh names Lysimachus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The Lysimachus named with Cornelius Tacitus, who gives the Pharaoh the name Bocchoris. Not the Macedonian Lysimachus of the chronological table. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter III, §. I, sig. 173b–174a
